description: This file defines the Filter class within the Api\V8\JsonApi\Repository namespace. The class provides methods for parsing filter conditions into SQL expressions, primarily for building database queries based on input parameters. It includes constants for comparison operators, a constructor accepting a database manager, and methods to parse filtering parameters, check operators, and handle deleted record filtering.

classes.name: Filter
classes.description: A class for constructing SQL filter conditions from input parameters, supporting various operators and handling custom fields and soft deletes.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Filter object with a database manager instance.

methods.name: parseWhere
methods.description: Parses input parameters into an SQL WHERE clause string, considering operators, custom fields, and deletion flags.

methods.name: addDeletedParameter
methods.description: Adds a default 'deleted' filter parameter to the input array; marked as deprecated.

methods.name: checkOperator
methods.description: Validates that a provided operator is defined as a constant within the class.
